en: {fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What will you be eating today?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}What should I get? I'm super hungry, so I could eat anything.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}May I join you?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Yeah, sure. What do you like, Angel?{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Didn't you just go for a meal a little while ago?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Earlier I went to the general store. I went to sell the carvings I made on my trip.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Something smells good.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}It really does. I wanna eat something soon.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Be sure to eat your vegetables too.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Y-yeah. I know...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What did you eat at home?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}My mom's cooking. Mom's a really good cook, so she makes all kinds of stuff.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you a big eater?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Heh heh. I look like one, huh? If I don't eat a lot, I've got no energy!{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Is there something else?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}May I join you?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Yeah, sure. But keep up, OK! I'm gonna run as hard as I can.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Does it help you unwind?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Yeah. Playing as hard as you can makes you feel great.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}How are you feeling?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I'm feeling good. Maybe 'cause I got a good night's sleep yesterday.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You seem to be in a good mood.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Heh heh, you think so? I bet something good's gonna happen today.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Please get some good rest.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Yeah. Thanks! You should play and get some rest too, Angel!{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like festivals?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Yeah! I love them! They sell way more stuff than usual in town.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I can't buy much, but festivals have all kinds of fun things, right?{n}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Don't you get tired from playing too much?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Ahaha. I'm fine, Angel! I told you, I'm not that much of a kid.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Is there... something else?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Please don't push yourself too hard.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Yeah... I know that, but...{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}That looks hard. Why not rest a bit?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}...But it's frustrating when I can't do it.{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you going to keep training today?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Yeah. 'Cause I wanna get good at throwing the boomerang soon.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Learning something every day is important, isn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}...Yeah. My dad used to say that too...{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}...Would it have been better if I hadn't come?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}That's not true... You came 'cause you had something to do, Angel. Right?{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Have you ever been hurt?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}All the time, back when I'd just learned the boomerang.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I couldn't catch it right when it came back.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Which do you like more, studying or training?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Hmm... If I had to pick, training, I guess.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Anything else?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}The breeze feels nice.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Yeah. Walking along like this, it's hard to believe the world's in chaos.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you tired...?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I'm all right. What about you, Angel? Aren't you tired? If you are, tell me.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you hungry?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Hmm... Now that you mention it, maybe I am. But didn't we just eat?{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Shall we rest a bit?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Nah, I'm fine. Thanks for looking out for me, Angel.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Does being with me tire you out?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Not really. What about you, Angel, aren't you tired? I tend to go at my own pace.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Shall we hurry a little more?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Yeah? I don't think we need to rush... This pace'll be fine, I'm sure.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is there anything you'd like to do right now?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Well... you can't spring that on me all of a sudden... I was just walking...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What do you usually enjoy doing?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}When I'm lying on my back looking at the sky. Looking at nothing but sky, it feels like I'm floating in it. Feels great.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}So I kinda envy you, Angel, since you can actually fly.{n}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is there anything you're careful about?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Not getting worked up over things, maybe? Never panicking, no matter what. Having some slack is pretty important.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You seem used to walking.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Huh? ...Was I walking too fast?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I thought I was keeping to your pace, at least...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you want to get stronger?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Well... I guess it's better to get stronger, but...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Even if I do, I'd rather not use that strength if I can help it.{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you thirsty?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I'm not thirsty myself.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}But if you're thirsty, Angel, let's take a little break.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:7880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like taking walks?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Yeah, I like them. Especially exploring places I don't usually go.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:8280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You're in quite a hurry.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Yeah? Then I'll try walking a little slower. But tell me if it's too slow.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:8C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Have you ever wanted to fly?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}You know, I've flown on the backs of dragons.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Flying feels amazing!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}If I could fly freely on my own wings, I bet it'd be even more fun.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:9680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is walking fun?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Yeah, it's fun. Walking and taking in the scenery is nice.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}But running's even more fun.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:A080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is running fun?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Yeah, it's really fun.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}When you run all out, the scenery goes flying past behind you in no time.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Walking and taking in the view like this is nice too, but running's even more fun.{n}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I just wondered what you were up to.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Yeah, I was just getting ready for bed. It's this late already.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Thank you for your hard work today.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Yeah, good work today. But you're probably more tired than me, Angel. You should get some rest.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Am I... intruding?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}You're not in the way. Though if you're planning to camp out here tonight, that'd be a problem...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Please get some good rest.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Thanks. You too, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Gotta sleep well tonight and do my best tomorrow too.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I thought we might talk a little...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Sorry for making you worry about me...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}But I say everything I want to say during the day, so there's nothing now.{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}It's a quiet night.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Yeah, a nice quiet night.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}We've got to make the world peaceful, so everyone can have nights like this every day...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I've got to try harder...{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you scared of the dark?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Nah, not at all. There's no light when I'm with the dragons.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Aul taught me: in the dark, you just feel things with your ears and your skin.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Do that, and there's nothing you can't make out, so it's not scary.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Anything else?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What will you be eating today?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Nothing fancy. ...Same as yesterday is fine by me.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}As long as I get to eat, I'm happy.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}May I join you?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Sure. Eating with two is more fun than eating alone.{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Didn't you just go for a meal a little while ago?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Yeah, a little while ago. What I'm going for now is a snack. I'm hungry today.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Something smells good.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Right! That great smell makes me even hungrier.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Be sure to eat your vegetables too.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}If you're worried I'm picky, don't be. I'm not picky at all.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you pay attention to nutrition?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Hmm... Thinking about that won't make the food taste any better...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I've never really thought about it. As long as I can eat my fill, I'm good.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Won't you talk a little more?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Nah... I appreciate it, but I'm about to eat. Didn't I say...?{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{spk:E783}{n}May I join you?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Sure, but I've only got gear for myself. I don't think just watching will be much fun, but if that's OK, wanna come?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0B80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Does it help you unwind?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}That's a hard question...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Fishing's fun, but when I don't catch a single one, it does wear me out...{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:1580}{n}{spk:E783}{n}How are you feeling?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I'm in a good mood right now.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}But when I come back disappointed without a single fish, just don't ask me that, OK?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1F80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You seem to be in a good mood.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Well, I'm off to do something I like, so naturally I'm in a good mood.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:2980}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Please get some good rest.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Yeah, thanks. I'm starting to feel like I'll catch something.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:3380}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Weren't you doing that yesterday too?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Yeah. But yesterday I didn't catch a single one.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Today I'm definitely catching enough to make up for it!{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3D80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Good luck out there.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Yeah. Thanks! I'll catch a big one for you, Angel!{n}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}So, are we done?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Please don't push yourself too hard.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I'm fine. I train at my own pace, so I won't overdo it.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}That looks hard. Why not rest a bit?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}...I'll pass. This is something I have to do right now.{n}{fe:E78300800280}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you going to keep training today?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Well, I can't stop at this much. I've got to keep going a bit longer.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Training's not that easy, you know.{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
